WITH tenant_filter AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM tenants WHERE name IN ('Marrowby & Vane','Studio Vrij','Cragsley Outfitters')
),
ticket_tags AS (
  SELECT t.id AS ticket_id, t.tenant_id, t.created_at, t.resolved_at, st.name AS tag_name
  FROM tickets t
  JOIN ticket_tags_map ttm ON ttm.ticket_id = t.id
  JOIN support_tags st ON st.id = ttm.support_tag_id
  JOIN tenant_filter tf ON tf.id = t.tenant_id
  WHERE t.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
tenant_totals AS (
  SELECT t.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS total_tickets
  FROM tickets t
  JOIN tenant_filter tf ON tf.id = t.tenant_id
  WHERE t.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY t.tenant_id
),
breaches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ticket_id FROM sla_breaches WHERE breach_kind = 'resolution'
)
SELECT
  tf.name AS tenant_name,
  tt.tag_name,
  COUNT(*) AS ticket_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / tot.total_tickets, 1) AS pct_of_tenant_tickets,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN tt.resolved_at IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tt.resolved_at - tt.created_at)) / 60.0 END)) AS avg_resolution_minutes,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ticket_id IS NOT NULL THEN tt.ticket_id END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS resolution_breach_rate
FROM ticket_tags tt
JOIN tenant_filter tf ON tf.id = tt.tenant_id
JOIN tenant_totals tot ON tot.tenant_id = tt.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN breaches b ON b.ticket_id = tt.ticket_id
GROUP BY tf.name, tt.tag_name, tot.total_tickets
ORDER BY tf.name, ticket_count DESC, tt.tag_name
note: avg_resolution_minutes is computed only over tickets with a non-null resolved_at (unresolved tickets in the 2025 window are excluded from that average but still counted in ticket_count and the breach-rate denominator); resolution_breach_rate = share of each (tenant, tag) ticket group with at least one sla_breaches row of breach_kind='resolution'. pct_of_tenant_tickets can sum to over 100% per tenant since a ticket may carry multiple tags.
